g.text: Figure 11. Subtype restriction tests whether older clone concentration reflects CD4/CD8 mixture. Fixed-depth
spleen contrasts at 24 versus 3 months are CD4 +0.0, CD8 +1.0 percentage points. Points are mice; bars are
means. Source annotations, sparse strata and unmeasured receptor recovery limit biological interpretation.
